    rVoted_TubeStrain := (rTubeStrain_Crown_B + rTubeStrain_Crown_C) * 0.5;
    bDegraded_Strain_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwSensorDegradedWord := dwSensorDegradedWord OR 16#0100_0000;
ELSIF bDiscrepancy_Strain_B AND NOT bDiscrepancy_Strain_A AND NOT bDiscrepancy_Strain_C THEN
    rVoted_TubeStrain := (rTubeStrain_Crown_A + rTubeStrain_Crown_C) * 0.5;
    bDegraded_Strain_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwSensorDegradedWord := dwSensorDegradedWord OR 16#0200_0000;
ELSIF bDiscrepancy_Strain_C AND NOT bDiscrepancy_Strain_A AND NOT bDiscrepancy_Strain_B THEN
    rVoted_TubeStrain := (rTubeStrain_Crown_A + rTubeStrain_Crown_B) * 0.5;
    bDegraded_Strain_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwSensorDegradedWord := dwSensorDegradedWord OR 16#0400_0000;
ELSE
    bFault_Strain_All := TRUE;
    dwTripErrorCode := dwTripErrorCode OR cTRIP_SENSOR_TOTAL_FAILURE;
    bReceiverTripped := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 3: TERNARY NITRATE MOLTEN SALT THERMODYNAMICS & TRANSPORT PHENOMENA ENGINE       *)
(* Real-time thermodynamic equations evaluated over dynamic bulk temperature T_bulk         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
rSaltBulkMeanTemp := (rVoted_SaltInletTemp + rVoted_SaltOutletTemp_Int) * 0.5;

(* Salt Density: rho(T) = 2090.0 - 0.636 * T_bulk [kg/m3] *)
rSaltDensity := 2090.0 - (0.636 * rSaltBulkMeanTemp);
IF rSaltDensity < 1650.0 THEN rSaltDensity := 1650.0; END_IF;

(* Specific Heat Capacity: cp(T) = 1443.0 + 0.172 * T_bulk [J/(kg*K)] *)
rSaltHeatCapacity := 1443.0 + (0.172 * rSaltBulkMeanTemp);

(* Dynamic Viscosity: mu(T) = 0.022714 - 1.20e-4*T + 2.281e-7*T^2 - 1.474e-10*T^3 [Pa*s] *)
rSaltViscosity := 0.022714 - (0.000120 * rSaltBulkMeanTemp) + 
                  (2.281E-7 * rSaltBulkMeanTemp * rSaltBulkMeanTemp) - 
                  (1.474E-10 * rSaltBulkMeanTemp * rSaltBulkMeanTemp * rSaltBulkMeanTemp);
IF rSaltViscosity < 0.0010 THEN rSaltViscosity := 0.0010; END_IF;

(* Thermal Conductivity: k(T) = 0.443 + 1.90e-4 * T_bulk [W/(m*K)] *)
rSaltThermalCond := 0.443 + (0.000190 * rSaltBulkMeanTemp);

(* Prandtl Number: Pr = (cp * mu) / k [-] *)
rSaltPrandtl := (rSaltHeatCapacity * rSaltViscosity) / rSaltThermalCond;

(* Mean Superficial Salt Tube Velocity [m/s] *)
rSaltFlowVelocity := rVoted_SaltMassFlow / (rSaltDensity * rTotalFlowArea);
IF rSaltFlowVelocity < 0.05 THEN rSaltFlowVelocity := 0.05; END_IF;

(* Reynolds Number: Re = (rho * v * d_i) / mu [-] *)
rSaltReynolds := (rSaltDensity * rSaltFlowVelocity * rTubeInnerDia) / rSaltViscosity;

(* Darcy Pipe Friction Factor via Haaland / Filonenko Correlation for Re > 3000 *)
IF rSaltReynolds > 3000.0 THEN
    (* f = (0.790 * ln(Re) - 1.64)^(-2) *)
    rSaltDarcyFriction := 1.0 / ((0.790 * LN(rSaltReynolds) - 1.64) * (0.790 * LN(rSaltReynolds) - 1.64));
ELSE
    rSaltDarcyFriction := 64.0 / rSaltReynolds;
END_IF;

(* Convective Nusselt Number via Gnielinski Correlation: *)
(* Nu = (f/8)*(Re - 1000)*Pr / (1.0 + 12.7*sqrt(f/8)*(Pr^(2/3) - 1.0)) *)
IF rSaltReynolds > 2300.0 THEN
    rSaltNusselt := ((rSaltDarcyFriction / 8.0) * (rSaltReynolds - 1000.0) * rSaltPrandtl) /
                    (1.0 + 12.7 * SQRT(rSaltDarcyFriction / 8.0) * (EXPT(rSaltPrandtl, 0.6667) - 1.0));
ELSE
    rSaltNusselt := 4.36; (* Laminar constant heat flux asymptotic limit *)
END_IF;

(* Internal Tube Convective Heat Transfer Coefficient h [W/(m2*K)] *)
rSaltHeatTransferCoeff := rSaltNusselt * (rSaltThermalCond / rTubeInnerDia);

(* Cavity Absorbed Thermal Enthalpy Power: Q_rec = m_dot * cp * (Tout - Tin) * 1e-6 [MW] *)
rCavityAbsorbedPower_MW := (rVoted_SaltMassFlow * rSaltHeatCapacity * (rVoted_SaltOutletTemp_Int - rVoted_SaltInletTemp)) * 1.0E-6;
rActiveThermalPower_MW := rCavityAbsorbedPower_MW;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: HAYNES 230 TUBE CROWN MULTI-AXIAL THERMAL STRESS & DYNAMIC STRAIN ENGINE       *)
(* Evaluates radial and circumferential thermal gradients, pressure stresses, and von Mises  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Temperature-Dependent Haynes 230 Alloy Properties at Peak Tube Crown Temp *)
rHaynes_E := (211000.0 - (65.0 * rVoted_TubeCrownTemp));
rHaynes_Alpha := (1.27E-5 + (4.5E-9 * rVoted_TubeCrownTemp));
rHaynes_Sy := (310.0 - (0.185 * rVoted_TubeCrownTemp));
IF rHaynes_Sy < 120.0 THEN rHaynes_Sy := 120.0; END_IF;
rHaynes_k_metal := 21.5 + (0.0150 * rVoted_TubeCrownTemp);

(* Radial Crown Temperature Gradient Across 2.11mm Superalloy Wall: *)
(* Delta_T_rad = (q''_peak * r_o * ln(r_o / r_i)) / k_metal *)
rDeltaT_RadialCrown := (rVoted_PeakFlux * (rTubeOuterDia * 0.5) * LN(rTubeOuterDia / rTubeInnerDia)) / rHaynes_k_metal;

(* Circumferential Crown-to-Back Gradient: *)
(* Delta_T_cir = (q''_peak * r_o) / (PI * k_metal) * (k_metal / (h_conv * r_i) + 1.0) *)
rDeltaT_Circumferential := ((rVoted_PeakFlux * (rTubeOuterDia * 0.5)) / (3.14159 * rHaynes_k_metal)) * 
                           ((rHaynes_k_metal / (rSaltHeatTransferCoeff * (rTubeInnerDia * 0.5))) + 1.0);

(* Axial Thermal Restraint Stress: *)
(* sigma_ax_th = (E * alpha * Delta_T_rad) / (2 * (1 - nu)) + (E * alpha * Delta_T_cir) / 4.0 *)
rSigma_Th_Axial := ((rHaynes_E * rHaynes_Alpha * rDeltaT_RadialCrown) / (2.0 * (1.0 - rHaynes_Nu))) + 
                   ((rHaynes_E * rHaynes_Alpha * rDeltaT_Circumferential) / 4.0);

(* Circumferential Hoop Thermal Stress: *)
(* sigma_hp_th = (E * alpha * Delta_T_rad) / (2 * (1 - nu)) *)
rSigma_Th_Hoop := (rHaynes_E * rHaynes_Alpha * rDeltaT_RadialCrown) / (2.0 * (1.0 - rHaynes_Nu));

(* Lamé Thick-Walled Cylinder Internal Salt Pressure Hoop Stress: *)
(* sigma_hp_pr = P_salt * (r_o^2 + r_i^2) / (r_o^2 - r_i^2) * 0.1 [MPa] *)
rSigma_Pr_Hoop := (rVoted_SaltDischargePress * 
                  ((rTubeOuterDia * rTubeOuterDia) + (rTubeInnerDia * rTubeInnerDia)) / 
                  ((rTubeOuterDia * rTubeOuterDia) - (rTubeInnerDia * rTubeInnerDia))) * 0.1;

(* Superimposed Total Multi-Axial Normal Stresses [MPa] *)
rSigma_Axial_Total := rSigma_Th_Axial + (rSigma_Pr_Hoop * 0.5);
rSigma_Hoop_Total := rSigma_Th_Hoop + rSigma_Pr_Hoop;
rSigma_Radial_Inner := -(rVoted_SaltDischargePress * 0.1); (* Compressive fluid pressure at inner wall *)

(* Combined Equivalent von Mises Stress: *)
(* sigma_vM = sqrt(0.5 * ((s_ax - s_hp)^2 + (s_hp - s_rad)^2 + (s_rad - s_ax)^2)) *)
rCalculatedVonMisesStress := SQRT(0.5 * (
    ((rSigma_Axial_Total - rSigma_Hoop_Total) * (rSigma_Axial_Total - rSigma_Hoop_Total)) +
    ((rSigma_Hoop_Total - rSigma_Radial_Inner) * (rSigma_Hoop_Total - rSigma_Radial_Inner)) +
    ((rSigma_Radial_Inner - rSigma_Axial_Total) * (rSigma_Radial_Inner - rSigma_Axial_Total))
));
rPeakTubeWallVonMisesStress := rCalculatedVonMisesStress;
rStressYieldRatio := rCalculatedVonMisesStress / rHaynes_Sy;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: 6TH-ORDER DISCRETE STATE-SPACE MODEL (Ad, Bd, Cd, Dd) & KALMAN OBSERVER        *)
(* Discretized state estimation and 1-step prediction at Ts = 50ms                          *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1-Step Ahead State Prediction: x_pred = Ad * x + Bd * u *)
x1_Pred := (Ad_11 * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Ad_12 * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Ad_13 * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + 
           (Ad_14 * x4_FlowDev) + (Ad_15 * x5_RadialGradDev) + (Ad_16 * x6_StrainDev) + 
           (Bd_11 * u1_FlowCmd_Prev) + (Bd_12 * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

x2_Pred := (Ad_21 * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Ad_22 * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Ad_23 * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + 
           (Ad_24 * x4_FlowDev) + (Ad_25 * x5_RadialGradDev) + (Ad_26 * x6_StrainDev) + 
           (Bd_21 * u1_FlowCmd_Prev) + (Bd_22 * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

x3_Pred := (Ad_31 * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Ad_32 * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Ad_33 * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + 
           (Ad_34 * x4_FlowDev) + (Ad_35 * x5_RadialGradDev) + (Ad_36 * x6_StrainDev) + 
           (Bd_31 * u1_FlowCmd_Prev) + (Bd_32 * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

x4_Pred := (Ad_41 * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Ad_42 * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Ad_43 * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + 
           (Ad_44 * x4_FlowDev) + (Ad_45 * x5_RadialGradDev) + (Ad_46 * x6_StrainDev) + 
           (Bd_41 * u1_FlowCmd_Prev) + (Bd_42 * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

x5_Pred := (Ad_51 * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Ad_52 * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Ad_53 * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + 
           (Ad_54 * x4_FlowDev) + (Ad_55 * x5_RadialGradDev) + (Ad_56 * x6_StrainDev) + 
           (Bd_51 * u1_FlowCmd_Prev) + (Bd_52 * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

x6_Pred := (Ad_61 * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Ad_62 * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Ad_63 * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + 
           (Ad_64 * x4_FlowDev) + (Ad_65 * x5_RadialGradDev) + (Ad_66 * x6_StrainDev) + 
           (Bd_61 * u1_FlowCmd_Prev) + (Bd_62 * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

(* Measurement Innovations / Residuals: e = y_meas - (Cd * x_pred + Dd * u) *)
e1_Resid := (rVoted_SaltOutletTemp_Int - rSetPoint_SaltTemp) - 
            ((Cd_11 * x1_Pred) + (Cd_12 * x2_Pred) + (Cd_13 * x3_Pred) + (Cd_14 * x4_Pred) + (Cd_15 * x5_Pred) + (Cd_16 * x6_Pred));

e2_Resid := (rVoted_TubeCrownTemp - 610.0) - 
            ((Cd_21 * x1_Pred) + (Cd_22 * x2_Pred) + (Cd_23 * x3_Pred) + (Cd_24 * x4_Pred) + (Cd_25 * x5_Pred) + (Cd_26 * x6_Pred));

e3_Resid := (rCalculatedVonMisesStress - 120.0) - 
            ((Cd_31 * x1_Pred) + (Cd_32 * x2_Pred) + (Cd_33 * x3_Pred) + (Cd_34 * x4_Pred) + (Cd_35 * x5_Pred) + (Cd_36 * x6_Pred));

e4_Resid := (rCavityAbsorbedPower_MW - 600.0) - 
            ((Cd_41 * x1_Pred) + (Cd_42 * x2_Pred) + (Cd_43 * x3_Pred) + (Cd_44 * x4_Pred) + (Cd_45 * x5_Pred) + (Cd_46 * x6_Pred));

(* Observer State Correction Update: x = x_pred + L * e *)
x1_SaltTempDev   := x1_Pred + (L_11 * e1_Resid) + (L_12 * e2_Resid) + (L_13 * e3_Resid) + (L_14 * e4_Resid);
x2_CrownTempDev  := x2_Pred + (L_21 * e1_Resid) + (L_22 * e2_Resid) + (L_23 * e3_Resid) + (L_24 * e4_Resid);
x3_ThermalPwrDev := x3_Pred + (L_31 * e1_Resid) + (L_32 * e2_Resid) + (L_33 * e3_Resid) + (L_34 * e4_Resid);
x4_FlowDev       := x4_Pred + (L_41 * e1_Resid) + (L_42 * e2_Resid) + (L_43 * e3_Resid) + (L_44 * e4_Resid);
x5_RadialGradDev := x5_Pred + (L_51 * e1_Resid) + (L_52 * e2_Resid) + (L_53 * e3_Resid) + (L_54 * e4_Resid);
x6_StrainDev     := x6_Pred + (L_61 * e1_Resid) + (L_62 * e2_Resid) + (L_63 * e3_Resid) + (L_64 * e4_Resid);

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) CONDENSED REAL-TIME QP OPTIMIZATION SOLVER      *)
(* Solves min J(du) = 0.5*du'*H*du + g'*du subject to actuator rate and amplitude bounds     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Condensed 2x2 Hessian Matrix Evaluation *)
H_11 := 2.0 * ((Bd_11 * Bd_11 * q1_Weight_SaltTemp) + (Bd_41 * Bd_41 * q4_Weight_Flow)) + r1_Weight_FlowCmd + s1_Weight_FlowRate;
H_12 := 2.0 * ((Bd_11 * Bd_12 * q1_Weight_SaltTemp) + (Bd_21 * Bd_22 * q2_Weight_CrownTemp));
H_21 := H_12;
H_22 := 2.0 * ((Bd_22 * Bd_22 * q2_Weight_CrownTemp) + (Bd_32 * Bd_32 * q3_Weight_ThermalPwr) + (Bd_62 * Bd_62 * q6_Weight_Strain)) + r2_Weight_DefocusCmd + s2_Weight_DefocusRate;

(* Determinant of Positive-Definite Hessian *)
rDet_H := (H_11 * H_22) - (H_12 * H_21);
IF rDet_H < 1.0E-6 THEN rDet_H := 1.0E-6; END_IF;

(* Linear Gradient Vector g (2x1) Accounting for Tracking Errors and Rate Penalties *)
g_1 := 2.0 * ((Bd_11 * q1_Weight_SaltTemp * x1_SaltTempDev) + (Bd_41 * q4_Weight_Flow * x4_FlowDev)) - (s1_Weight_FlowRate * u1_FlowCmd_Prev);
g_2 := 2.0 * ((Bd_22 * q2_Weight_CrownTemp * x2_CrownTempDev) + (Bd_32 * q3_Weight_ThermalPwr * x3_ThermalPwrDev) + (Bd_62 * q6_Weight_Strain * x6_StrainDev)) - (s2_Weight_DefocusRate * u2_DefocusCmd_Prev);

(* Unconstrained Analytical Global Minimum: du_unc = -H^(-1) * g *)
du1_unc := ((-g_1 * H_22) + (g_2 * H_12)) / rDet_H;
du2_unc := ((-g_2 * H_11) + (g_1 * H_21)) / rDet_H;

(* Slew-Rate Box Constraints: Max Delta per 50ms scan *)
IF du1_unc > (rMaxFlowSlewRate_kg_s2 * rCycleTime_s) THEN
    du1_opt := rMaxFlowSlewRate_kg_s2 * rCycleTime_s;
ELSIF du1_unc < -(rMaxFlowSlewRate_kg_s2 * rCycleTime_s) THEN
    du1_opt := -(rMaxFlowSlewRate_kg_s2 * rCycleTime_s);
ELSE
    du1_opt := du1_unc;
END_IF;

IF du2_unc > (rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s) THEN
    du2_opt := rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s;
ELSIF du2_unc < -(rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s) THEN
    du2_opt := -(rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s);
ELSE
    du2_opt := du2_unc;
END_IF;

(* Projected Gradient Conditional Adjustment if du1 Hit Constraint *)
IF du1_opt <> du1_unc THEN
    du2_opt := (-g_2 - (H_12 * du1_opt)) / H_22;
    IF du2_opt > (rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s) THEN
        du2_opt := rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s;
    ELSIF du2_opt < -(rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s) THEN
        du2_opt := -(rMaxDefocusSlewRate_1_s * rCycleTime_s);
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Integrated Total Actuator Control Move Commands *)
u1_FlowCmd_Prev := u1_FlowCmd_Prev + du1_opt;
u2_DefocusCmd_Prev := u2_DefocusCmd_Prev + du2_opt;

(* Bound Global Control Amplitudes *)
IF (rNominalFlow_kg_s + u1_FlowCmd_Prev) > rMaxPermissibleFlow_kg_s THEN
    u1_FlowCmd_Prev := rMaxPermissibleFlow_kg_s - rNominalFlow_kg_s;
ELSIF (rNominalFlow_kg_s + u1_FlowCmd_Prev) < rMinPermissibleFlow_kg_s THEN
    u1_FlowCmd_Prev := rMinPermissibleFlow_kg_s - rNominalFlow_kg_s;
END_IF;

IF u2_DefocusCmd_Prev > 0.65 THEN
    u2_DefocusCmd_Prev := 0.65;
ELSIF u2_DefocusCmd_Prev < 0.0 THEN
    u2_DefocusCmd_Prev := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Master Continuous Output Actuator Demands *)
IF (iState = 40) OR (iState = 50) THEN
    rSaltPumpFlowDemand := rNominalFlow_kg_s + u1_FlowCmd_Prev;
    rTargetFluxDefocusRatio := u2_DefocusCmd_Prev;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: EMERGENCY CLOUD-COVER TRANSIENT DETECTION & FAST DEFLECTION (EDS) SYSTEM       *)
(* Executes sub-250ms emergency aim-point divert upon severe cloud-edge DNI rate of collapse *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
rDNI_RateOfChange := (rVoted_DNI - rPreviousDNI) / rCycleTime_s;
rPreviousDNI := rVoted_DNI;

(* Cloud Edge Transient Detection Trigger *)
bCloudTransientDetected := (rDNI_RateOfChange < rFastDeflectRateThreshold) OR bCloudShadowAnticipationTrigger;

IF bCloudTransientDetected AND NOT bFastDeflectLatched AND ((iState = 40) OR (iState = 50)) THEN
    bFastDeflectLatched := TRUE;
    bFastDeflectionActive := TRUE;
    iState := 60; (* Immediate Jump to Fast Aim-Point Deflection State *)
    dwWarningCode := dwWarningCode OR cWARN_DNI_RAPID_DROP;
END_IF;

(* Fast Deflection Trajectory Generator *)
IF bFastDeflectionActive THEN
    (* Rapidly displace optical centroid vertically above cavity aperture into celestial standby *)
    rAimPointShift_X := 0.0;
    rAimPointShift_Y := rStandbyApertureClearance_m;
    rTargetFluxDefocusRatio := 1.0; (* 100% Beam Shedding Defocus *)
    
    (* Controlled downward salt flow ramp to match residual cavity thermal decay and avoid quenching *)
    IF rSaltPumpFlowDemand > 350.0 THEN
        rSaltPumpFlowDemand := rSaltPumpFlowDemand - (120.0 * rCycleTime_s);
    ELSE
        rSaltPumpFlowDemand := 350.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rAimPointShift_X := 0.0;
    rAimPointShift_Y := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: MULTI-HELIOSTAT FIELD DYNAMIC AIM-POINT SHADING & MULTI-PANEL SMOOTHING        *)
(* Coordinates 4 quadrant sectors and 16 serpentine absorber panels to limit peak local flux *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Sector Attenuation Allocations *)
rSector_NE_Defocus := rTargetFluxDefocusRatio * 1.05;
rSector_NW_Defocus := rTargetFluxDefocusRatio * 1.02;
rSector_SE_Defocus := rTargetFluxDefocusRatio * 0.96;
rSector_SW_Defocus := rTargetFluxDefocusRatio * 0.97;

IF rSector_NE_Defocus > 1.0 THEN rSector_NE_Defocus := 1.0; END_IF;
IF rSector_NW_Defocus > 1.0 THEN rSector_NW_Defocus := 1.0; END_IF;

IF rSector_SW_Defocus > 1.0 THEN rSector_SW_Defocus := 1.0; END_IF;

(* Spatial Gaussian Flux Smoothing Across 16 Serpentine Panels: *)
(* Simulates multi-point aiming spreading across cavity width *)
rPanelPeakFlux_1  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NW_Defocus) * 0.52;
rPanelPeakFlux_2  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NW_Defocus) * 0.68;
rPanelPeakFlux_3  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NW_Defocus) * 0.81;
rPanelPeakFlux_4  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NW_Defocus) * 0.91;
rPanelPeakFlux_5  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 0.96;
rPanelPeakFlux_6  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 0.99;
rPanelPeakFlux_7  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 1.00;
rPanelPeakFlux_8  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 0.98;
rPanelPeakFlux_9  := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 0.98;
rPanelPeakFlux_10 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 1.00;
rPanelPeakFlux_11 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 0.99;
rPanelPeakFlux_12 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rTargetFluxDefocusRatio) * 0.95;
rPanelPeakFlux_13 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NE_Defocus) * 0.90;
rPanelPeakFlux_14 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NE_Defocus) * 0.79;
rPanelPeakFlux_15 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NE_Defocus) * 0.65;
rPanelPeakFlux_16 := rActivePeakFlux * (1.0 - rSector_NE_Defocus) * 0.49;

(* Automatic Dynamic Flux Shading Engagement When Thresholds Approached *)
IF (rActivePeakFlux > 1050000.0) OR (rVoted_TubeStrain > 1800.0) OR (rCalculatedVonMisesStress > 165.0) THEN
    bFluxShadingEngaged := TRUE;
    rPeakShavingTrimFactor := 0.88;
    IF iState = 40 THEN
        iState := 50; (* Transition from Normal Baseload to Dynamic Shading *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bFluxShadingEngaged := FALSE;
    rPeakShavingTrimFactor := 1.00;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 9: CUMULATIVE HIGH-TEMPERATURE CREEP-FATIGUE LIFE CONSUMPTION ACCUMULATOR         *)
(* Norton-Bailey secondary creep integration and Rainflow strain reversal cycle tracker      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* High-Temperature Creep Rate: edot_cr = A * sigma^n * exp(-Q/(R*T_kelvin)) [1/h] *)
rInstantaneousCreepRate_1_hr := rNorton_A * EXPT(rCalculatedVonMisesStress, rNorton_n) * 
                               EXP(-rNorton_Q_R / (rVoted_TubeCrownTemp + 273.15));

(* Approximate Larson-Miller Time-to-Rupture [h] *)
IF rCalculatedVonMisesStress > 50.0 THEN
    rTimeToRupture_Hours := EXPT(10.0, (28.5 - 7.5 * (LN(rCalculatedVonMisesStress)/2.302585))) * 
                            (1000.0 / (rVoted_TubeCrownTemp + 273.15));
    IF rTimeToRupture_Hours < 1.0 THEN rTimeToRupture_Hours := 1.0; END_IF;
ELSE
    rTimeToRupture_Hours := 1.0E7;
END_IF;

(* Incremental Creep Damage Fraction Consumed in 50ms Scan Cycle: Delta_D = Delta_t / t_rup *)
rDeltaCreepDamageCycle := (rCycleTime_s / 3600.0) / rTimeToRupture_Hours;
rCumulativeCreepDamage := rCumulativeCreepDamage + rDeltaCreepDamageCycle;

(* Low-Cycle Thermal Fatigue Reversal Counting (Rainflow Half-Cycle Approximation) *)
rDeltaStrainReversal := ABS(rVoted_TubeStrain - rPreviousMicrostrain);
IF rDeltaStrainReversal > 150.0 THEN
    (* Significant thermal strain excursion: Coffin-Manson low-cycle fatigue damage increment *)
    rCyclesToFailure_Nf := 1.5E9 * EXPT(rDeltaStrainReversal, -2.25);
    IF rCyclesToFailure_Nf < 1000.0 THEN rCyclesToFailure_Nf := 1000.0; END_IF;
